scripts.dev: cross-env CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL=1000 tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=test NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --runInBand --coverage
scripts.reset: npx prisma migrate reset --force && npm run seed
scripts.db-test:start: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env.test -f docker-compose.test-db.yml up -d
scripts.prod:start: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.prod:rebuild: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml build --no-cache && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.dev:start: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev:rebuild: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.dev:reset: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml build --no-cache && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.server:start: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.server:rebuild: cd .. && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml build --no-cache && docker compose --env-file server/.env -f docker-compose.yml up -d
